notes.title: A new beginning.
notes.content:
Greetings, summoner.

You are already 500 summoners willing to join the world of Elderon! Here is a [b]gift to thank you for your support:[/b]

Every summoner launching the game during the first week post-release will [b]receive a reward[/b], including decorations, resources, and [b]the exclusive Elder Flame[/b]! 

[b]Wishlist the game now so you do not miss the next announcements! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341323/9008489597404d0629cc6fd28537d7724ad753bc.png[/img]

notes.title: PID Games Conference – Thank you for watching!
notes.content:
Will you be good enough to join the guardians of Elderon? 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VOFGexsDMkk&t=60s

It was announced during the last PID Games Conference: PID Games joins Ablaze Interactive and PlayJoy to bring you Guardians of Elderon in 2023! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341323/7fffa6e60517b6fc3a31b5bd8b5a54e327cf4058.png[/img]

Make sure to wishlist the game to get the latest news about the game!

notes.title: Something's coming
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341323/af19eebc13bdd1f8f8ec49f0252d8c8860dc9f34.png[/img]

Greetings summoner.
Prepare yourself, it all starts on the 22nd of December. There’s no fight intended on this date but there will be a special event on Twitch at 20.00 CET. 

https://www.twitch.tv/pidgameslive

Want to be sure you don’t miss it? Start to follow us today on Twitch! And don’t forget to wishlist the game to get the latest news.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2209820/Guardians_of_Elderon/
